title: factdiff.py anchor --file --refetch does not refetch a gone anchor row inside its 7-day backoff
goal: anchor --file F --refetch fetches the source of each gone row of F's facts whatever its age, as kb/_self/tools.md says --refetch ignores the cache, while a run without --refetch keeps the 7-day backoff of ST-yb5x4x3d; the anchor part of test_live_kb.py proves both (no new test id). Found by the SP-b36246xo review (S4).

run: import inspect,sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import factdiff as f;s=inspect.getsource(f.cmd_anchor);l=[x for x in s.splitlines() if 'again =' in x][0];print(l.strip());sys.exit(0 if 'refetch' in l else 1)

repro_reason: the behaviour needs a planted _anchors.csv with a gone row, a stubbed fetch and a topic file; the anchor part of test_live_kb.py is where the fix plants them, so the repro reads the retry condition in cmd_anchor
